title: Public Shorts Trend Evidence Contract
summary: The public repository carries only provenance-rich trend metadata; raw source payloads and operating identities remain private.

sections.heading: Allowed evidence
bullets: Public news and community metadata with provenance and rights state.
Hash-addressed transform receipts and bounded confidence bands.

sections.heading: Forbidden evidence
bullets: Raw payload bodies, captions, comments, transcripts, or media.
OAuth material, cookies, browser sessions, account IDs, or channel IDs.
Private revenue, household, or local filesystem details.
Collector configuration that enables network writes.

sections.heading: Freshness and decision use
paragraphs: Non-authorized YouTube API data expires no later than thirty days after retrieval and must then be refreshed or deleted. Trend observations are hypothesis inputs only; they cannot directly approve claims, publication, or scaling.
bullets: Keep event time separate from retrieval time.
Bind source URI and payload hashes without publishing either body.
Let the private evidence gate combine this metadata with claim, rights, originality, disclosure, and policy evidence.

sections.heading: Verification
